name: equal exact matches at equal distance on both sides of loc: the left one wins
source: independent: diff-match-patch 1.0.5 match_main under Bun 1.4.5 (Match_Threshold 0.4, Match_Distance 100000, Match_MaxBits 32). "retry=5" occurs at 0 and at 20, both 10 characters from loc 10, so both score 0.0001. Bitap scans right to left, accepts 20 first, moves start to 2 * loc - best = 0, then reaches 0 with an equal score and accepts it (the threshold is inclusive). This pins the left edge 2 * loc - best: an edge any further right misses the match at 0 and returns 20.

name: the only exact occurrence is more than 40000 characters from loc: no match
source: independent: diff-match-patch 1.0.5 match_main under Bun 1.4.5 (Match_Threshold 0.4, Match_Distance 100000, Match_MaxBits 32). The only exact occurrence is at 40001, score 0.40001 > 0.4. The initial tightening is min(score, THRESHOLD), so the threshold stays 0.4 and nothing is accepted.
